purpose: Read selected native MassFluid/MassBound/Dp/Idp/Pos/Vel/Rhop fields and per-step time brackets for the actual ROOT277 same-CFL and ROOT278 half-CFL pair.

terminal_sources.selected_policy: frame 0 plus actual lower/upper Part IDs for each query; actual final frame retained; selected array index is never a native Part ID

observables.weighted_fields: fluid-only native MassFluid weighted COM/velocity/KE; fixed/moving excluded
observables.time: RunPARTs actual time and decoder TimeStep; no interpolation or extrapolation
observables.dt: DtAllInfo/RunPARTs metadata remains a separate step-time diagnostic; no saved-time bracket is an error bound

qualification.reason: same/half saved times are asynchronous except t=0; no producer world-axis proof; neighboring grids are not truth

preconditions: ROOT277 and ROOT278 receipt/proof/request/RunPARTs exact joins pass
ten selected Part source records have concrete SHA and full stat from a parent snapshot
same/half output roots remain the actual terminal roots
source XML/decoder/observer small records remain stable
parent V8 reservation and child wrapper enforce cancellation, log, scratch, and post-source checks
